Record Class PlaceTotemCommand

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
shared.command.gameCommand.PlaceTotemCommand
Record Components:
playerName - the sender player's name
tileId - identifier of the tile to place the totem on
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, ClientCommand, GameCommand
public record PlaceTotemCommand(String playerName, char tileId) extends Record implements GameCommand
Game command: the player places their totem on an offer tile.
